history.sg_progress: Since 2023, the United Nations Office at Vienna has been managing liquidity constraints related to regular budget funding. In this regard, a structured process for prioritizing allocations has been developed, which includes continuous monitoring and adjustment of priorities based on the evolving financial situation and inputs from substantive offices, the Director-General of the United Nations Office at Vienna and the Office of the Controller. While the prioritization mechanism is currently operational, it will be formalized and documented accordingly.
